title: melicope sessilis

It is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using Melicope sessilis for medicinal purposes, but it has shown promise in traditional medicine practices.
